in_marathi.name: Sugriv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे He who has a strong grip
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sugriv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sugriva is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sugriha’ which means 'he who has a strong grip'. In Hindu mythology, Sugriva was the king of the monkey kingdom, Kishkindha, who was known for his strength and loyalty towards his brother Vali.
